summary: Smoke test of Vercel production deployment https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/admin FAILED at the very first step. The app renders a blank white page because all static JS/CSS assets return index.html (HTML) instead of their real content. Root cause: overly broad SPA rewrite in frontend/vercel.json catches every path (including /admin/static/*), while the CRA build placed real assets at /static/* (Vercel serves the build folder from its root, PUBLIC_URL=/admin only rewrote in-HTML references). Because the JS bundle never executes, no route/redirect/login form renders, and none of the 6 requested test cases can be exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: SPA rewrite '/(.*) -> /index.html' catches static assets. Request to /admin/static/js/main.67a744e3.js returns content-type text/html (index.html body, identical etag). Browser throws 'Unexpected token <' and React never mounts. App at https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/admin/ is a blank white page.

integration_issues.flow: All flows (login / dashboard / deep link /admin/customers / logout / sales role)
integration_issues.issue: Untestable — JS bundle never loads. login-username-input never appears (wait_for_selector timeout). Only 1 of 6 requested checks could even be attempted; asset URL discovery in HTML source confirms references are /admin/static/... but those return HTML.

action_items:
Fix /app/frontend/vercel.json rewrites so /admin/static/* is mapped to the real assets and only non-asset routes fall through to index.html. Suggested config:
{
  "installCommand": "yarn install",
  "buildCommand": "yarn build",
  "rewrites": [
    { "source": "/admin/static/(.*)", "destination": "/static/$1" },
    { "source": "/admin/favicon.ico", "destination": "/favicon.ico" },
    { "source": "/admin/manifest.json", "destination": "/manifest.json" },
    { "source": "/admin/asset-manifest.json", "destination": "/asset-manifest.json" },
    { "source": "/admin", "destination": "/index.html" },
    { "source": "/admin/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html" }
  ]
}
Alternative: move build output into a build/admin/ subdirectory so paths line up naturally (e.g., set outputDirectory or use a custom postbuild step), OR remove PUBLIC_URL=/admin and host at Vercel root.

After redeploy, re-run this iteration to verify: (1) /admin/ redirects to /admin/login, (2) superadmin login → 8 KPI cards + trend chart, (3) deep link /admin/customers renders table, (4) API calls hit oxly-crm.emergent.host with CORS OK, (5) sales login (adminz/admin123) shows 6 KPI cards without expense card, (6) logout returns to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: vercel.json rewrite is too greedy: '/(.*) -> /index.html' will always shadow static assets when combined with a non-root basename. Standard pattern is to either scope rewrite to app routes only or serve assets at the same prefix as basename.

PUBLIC_URL=/admin at build time hardcodes the /admin/static/... paths into the built HTML. If Vercel's project outputDirectory is 'build/', those URLs will 404 (and here get rewritten to index.html) unless an explicit rewrite bridges /admin/static -> /static.
Root domain (https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/) also returns index.html but still references /admin/static/... assets, so even the root URL is broken by design of PUBLIC_URL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The fix is a 1-file config change to /app/frontend/vercel.json (see action_items). After main agent redeploys to Vercel, retest the 6 flows from the request. Preview env (oxly-admin.preview.emergentagent.com) already passed in iterations 1-6 so no changes to app code should be required. Evidence: curl -I https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/admin/static/js/main.67a744e3.js returns content-type: text/html with same etag as /admin/ index.html, while curl -I https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/static/js/main.67a744e3.js returns proper JS with 'cache-control: s-maxage=31536000, immutable'.
rca of the issue: REPRO: (1) GET https://airoxly-admin.vercel.app/admin/ -> 200 HTML that references src='/admin/static/js/main.67a744e3.js'. (2) GET that JS URL -> 200 with content-type text/html and body starting '<!doctype html>' (same etag fd081429e9af98ac79942e43d6c6f259 as index.html). (3) Browser console shows 'Unexpected token <'. (4) React never mounts, so <BrowserRouter basename='/admin'> never runs the /admin -> /login redirect and no data-testid elements render. CAUSE: frontend/vercel.json rewrite '/(.*) -> /index.html' matches static asset requests before Vercel can serve them from the build output (which stores them at /static/*, not /admin/static/*). PUBLIC_URL=/admin only rewrites references inside index.html; it does not change the filesystem layout of the build folder. MITIGATION: add explicit /admin/static/(.*) -> /static/$1 rewrite (and similar for favicon/manifest) before the generic /admin/(.*) -> /index.html fallback, then redeploy.
